messages.subject: Atlas - thoughts on Vesey mark-up before we respond
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom,

Quick steer before I draft our response on the SPA. I think we concede the 50% cap and 18 months - they are within market and Charles is relaxed. I would hold firmer on the baskets (split the difference around GBP 30k/GBP 400k) and push back to 30 months on the covenants. The real protection we need is on the HMRC VAT point - I want a standalone capped indemnity rather than relying solely on the tax covenant. Tom, can you draft that wording from the DD report?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
